id._desc: id of the poem (points to a source file)

year_created._desc: year when poem created (may precede date of publication); cases when this is given as a time span in source data (e.g. 1800-1802) are stored as a list [1800,1802];

neighbors._desc: 20 most similar poems (Fuzz partial ratio) by the same author - each one is encoded in a list as [id, similarity] in descending order

duplicate._desc: whether poem is considered to be a duplicate of other poem, if so id of the primary variant is given here (this is not a straightforward application of neighbors, but involves a set of rules and a bunch of manually decided cases)

_self._desc: geolocations detected in the poem,  False if poem was not subject to geolocation recognition

loc_start._desc: first word of geolocation entity encoded as [line_i, word_i], bothe indices are zero-based

loc_end._desc: last word of geolocation entity encoded as [line_i, word_i], bothe indices are zero-based

_self._desc: metadata on poem's author; when poem has multiple authors this is a list holding multiple dicts

name._desc: name of the author as appears in the source (may be a pen name); if author is unknown, it is stored here as [anonymous]

country._desc: country where author from (iso 639-1), None if unknown or of no importance for the corpus

corpus._desc: name of the corpus from which the data come from (e.g. PoeTree.de comprise metricalizer and dlk [Deutsches Lyrik Korpus])

_self._desc: each dict is a line of the poem and holds it text and annotation

id._desc: index of the line; zero-based indexing, increment through the entire poem (does not restart in new stanza)

part._desc: if verse-line is divided into multiple text-lines, this gives whether this is initial part (value="I"), medial part (value="M"), or final part (value="F"); False if this is a non-divided line

_self._desc: annotation of particular word in CoNLL-U format

id._desc: word index, integer starting at 1 for each new sentence

lemma._desc: lemma or stem of word form

xpos._desc: language-specific part-of-speech tag; underscore if not available

feats._desc: list of morphological features from the universal feature inventory or from a defined language-specific extension; underscore if not available

head._desc: head of the current word, which is either a value of ID or zero (0)

deprel._desc: universal dependency relation to the HEAD (root iff HEAD = 0) or a defined language-specific subtype of one

deps._desc: enhanced dependency graph in the form of a list of head-deprel pairs

_self._desc: This key is optional! Appears only if given word is part of a multiword token

id._desc: multiword index, integer starting at 1 for each new sentence; e.g. "vámonos" produce two words "vámos" & "nos" - they both have a unique id and are assigned to multiword with form "vámonos" and a single id
